description: Check how ready any public website is for AI assistants and crawlers (5-15 s): llms.txt, robots.txt rules per AI bot (GPTBot, ClaudeBot and others), agents.txt, MCP and OpenAPI discovery, structured data. Returns a 0-100 score, grade and every check. The same check as internetsecure.org/ai-readiness. Uses 1 scan from the daily quota.
name: check_ai_readiness
